e2e.//: Owns the API 36 emulator, installed applications, adb bridge and support-owned disposable Synapse lifecycle.

runner-smoke.//: Node test runner smoke against the verified production renderer, API 36 emulator and support-owned Synapse lifecycle.

options.command: TRINITY_E2E_PROJECT=trinity-e2e-android TRINITY_E2E_PREBUILT_WWW=1 node scripts/web-bundle-manifest.mjs verify dist/web-bundle-manifest.json www && TRINITY_E2E_PROJECT=trinity-e2e-android TRINITY_E2E_PREBUILT_WWW=1 node e2e/support/run-node.mts --suite=runner.android --entrypoint=e2e/android/runner-smoke.mts --platform=android --bundle-manifest --resource=android-avd --resource=synapse
